g.title: Common
g.text: Heavy blue: cascade-delete | Thin orange: weak | Gray: stored data
Open triangle: one slot (may be null) | Filled triangle: many | Arrows: parent / holder → child / value

a.xlink:title: Agent.children → Agent; strong; many; reverse: Agent.agentParent; Child Agents are also owned by Ensemble; this is not a tree.
Agent.jobs → Jobs; strong; one slot; reverse: Jobs.parent
Agent.mcp → Mcp; strong; one slot; reverse: Mcp.parent
Agent.skills → Skills; strong; one slot; reverse: Skills.parent
Agent.tools → Tool; strong; many; reverse: Tool.parent
Agent.calls → ToolCallPart; data; many; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
Job.directoryListing → DirectoryListing; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
Job.fileEvidence → FileEvidence; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
Job.searchEvidence → SearchEvidence; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
Job.call → ToolCallPart; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
Job.structuredResult → ToolResultPart; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
Jobs.children → Job; strong; many; reverse: Job.parent
Jobs.nextLimits → JobLimits; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
Mcp.browser → McpBrowser; strong; one slot; reverse: McpBrowser.parent
Mcp.clients → McpClient; strong; many; reverse: McpClient.parent
McpBrowser.transport → IMcpTransport; strong; one slot; Before claim the registration disposes transport; after claim it destroys its client instead.
McpBrowser.client → McpClient; strong; one slot; reverse: McpClient.browserOwner
McpClient.transport → IMcpTransport; strong; one slot; Owned external I/O boundary: disposal, not a modeled parent back-reference.
McpClient.catalog → McpToolDefinition; data; many; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
McpClient.tools → Tool; strong; many; reverse: Tool.remote
McpProcessTransport.wire → McpStreamTransport; strong; one slot; Owned transport implementation; no model parent back-reference.
Skills.clients → McpClient; strong; many; reverse: McpClient.skillOwner
Skills.definitions → SkillDefinition; data; many; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
ToolResultPart.DirectoryListing → DirectoryListing; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
ToolResultPart.FileEvidence → FileEvidence; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
ToolResultPart.SearchEvidence → SearchEvidence; data; one slot; Stored type reference; no cascade-delete claim.
